findings: Exact source and test adapter verification: crates/mori-core/tests/financial_pair.rs (SHA256 eb77351e8cdf167de0a9b77cec14f10f248b9916fd70c2047da787d5aaa2f1d4) invokes the real public mori_core::parse, mori_core::validate, and mori_core::simulate consumers on crates/fixtures/financial-pair/actus-stk04/source.mori (SHA256 2a1b921fe038520969fb1ef26dd97dfc7116644c93fe9c5de3806b999ab2412b), opening.scenario.json (SHA256 656e74005ec45a8ec8d32a274782692081328aad7e478f17529ed9f617049f9d), and call-operands.json (SHA256 f54fdd2e30d5d1cb2a7644ef15f4a42b87717d619d583f8dbe993fde27bb4344). The three SHA256 assertions using sha2::Sha256::digest formatted via existing public mori_core::intent::hex qualify only literal byte identity of those three inputs against oracle.json input_subject, not semantic proof or a financial oracle.

Direct Core trace and successor-state verification: The test executes two linked actions (purchase at eventTime 20130101000000 and terminate at eventTime 20161231235959) against independent/oracle.json (raw SHA256 a697b6405effee41bc4860f5419673ae942726bb0318fa5a6c5c7b3d39266906). It verifies non-mutation of input scenarios, language/semantics profile (moriarty/1, moriarty-core/1), complete normalized pre/post snapshots (state, balances, liabilities), all 14 steps across the 2 calls (7 steps per call: 3 Requires, 1 Transfer, 2 Next, 1 Emit) including step ordinals, typed Step.value, full Step.snapshot, Step.effects deltas, cumulative effect_prefix, non-ExprId statement wire members (after removing and verifying u64 typing of unasserted numeric ExprId fields predicate/amount/value), and the complete 8-element ordered effect history. Expected snapshots are strictly comparison-only; the terminate call scenario is constructed directly from purchase actual Execution.post (state, balances, liabilities) plus the terminate input custody eventTime.

Four-field ACTUS semantic adapter verification: stk04_independent_cashflow extracts only the four supported ACTUS semantic fields (eventDate, eventType, payoff_signed_decimal, currency) from actual Execution.effects (one Transfer and one Emit per call, ignoring State effects and rejecting any other effect kind). For stk04 (contractRole RPA, R(RPA)=+1, EUR scale 0, no settlementCurrency FX=1), purchase transfers 1200 EUR from investor to counterparty yielding PRD at 2013-01-01T00:00:00 with payoff_signed_decimal -1200 (balances: counterparty 3000->4200, investor 2000->800), and terminate transfers 3000 EUR from counterparty to investor yielding TD at 2016-12-31T23:59:59 with payoff_signed_decimal 3000 (balances: counterparty 4200->1200, investor 800->3800; net investor delta +1800, counterparty -1800, total balance conserved at 5000, zero fees and zero liabilities). The YYYYMMDDhhmmss to ISO-8601 formatting is a mechanical display adapter over supplied integer inputs, not a schedule generator or calendar implementation.

Original compile failure and minimal a2 repair: The initial run on commit 7392aaf0a708339c1010679f133dd9e2f02d4b34 (tree e6349c348ac24359a64c075f0550cd7519f97c19) failed at compilation with exitCode 101 in 25.9267s due to three E0277 LowerHex trait errors on sha2 0.11.0 hybrid-array digests before any financial assertion ran. The minimal a2 repair on commit df149c245d632853665a8a704e5e0f89176427f1 (tree a98ca0190564c9a078a091ac8a4eefc0c793f7bd) replaced only those three format! expressions with mori_core::intent::hex(&sha2::Sha256::digest(...)), leaving all oracle bytes, fixture inputs, dependencies, and product runtime code unchanged. The repaired a2 run passed (exitCode 0 in 26.5941s: 1 passed, 0 failed, 2 filtered out) under frozen/offline/single-threaded/no-default-features constraints, with both attempts and owned SID/temp-root cleanup records retained honestly.

Changed-consumer/config predicate and guarded integration on current6c6e/treeb44043 and actualmain74a909: No test execution occurred on currentSourceCommit 6c6e29651dc01322bb7eb8a18fc98b3c1e818231 (tree b44043fba64fa2bd396d18412adb3472434c70ac); the only observed PASS is on df149c245d632853665a8a704e5e0f89176427f1 (tree a98ca0190564c9a078a091ac8a4eefc0c793f7bd). Across the 86 upstream changed paths from PR215 (50 multi-condition paths) and PR216 (36 disjoint-product paths) leading to actualMain 74a909d69639df8823a527a4d608a7516ccd69a2 (tree f18c2346ff435f9ac95a7f6f56457c2edde3f71c), all 42 candidate paths are byte-identical, and only 4 prior tracked files changed: crates/mori/Cargo.toml and crates/mori/src/commands/test.rs (in the unselected mori CLI package), plus crates/mori-core/Cargo.toml (adding non-default feature core2-disjoint-draft = []) and crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs (adding #[cfg(feature = "core2-disjoint-draft")] pub mod disjoint;). Because the selected consumer runs with -p mori-core --no-default-features --test financial_pair, the core2-disjoint-draft feature and its disjoint module/test target are inactive and excluded from compilation, while Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, mori-lexer, all active mori-core modules (ir, runtime, parser, intent, logical_cost, policy, replay, source_sponsor, stage), financial_pair.rs, and all 41 actus-stk04 fixture files are byte-identical to df149/a98ca. Thus no retest is required if and only if the pre-integration guard holds.
limitations: Not a globally blind review or globally blind oracle derivation: the source author had implementation and prior author-derived expectation exposure, and the independent oracle custodian derived expectations from post-input-custody operands and normative/DTO clauses while having prior exposure to unrelated repository audits and Core/2 DTO work (as disclosed in PROVENANCE.json).

Not an all-field or full-fixture ACTUS pass: only 4 of the 7 present ACTUS result fields (eventDate, eventType, payoff_signed_decimal, currency) are semantically asserted; the remaining 3 present ACTUS result fields (notionalPrincipal, nominalInterestRate, accruedInterest) remain unasserted obligations (the three zero-valued Core UInt state slots in source.mori are placeholder states, not established ACTUS mappings, and notionalPrincipal=1000 in stk04.normative-operands.json is unmapped). Zero full ACTUS fixture passes (0 of 277 fixtures, 18 executable types, 32 taxonomy dispositions, DS01-DS07) are counted, and all parent exits remain open.

Unasserted wire, cost, and target surfaces: numeric ExprId allocation values, whole serialized Program/Statement/Execution JSON wire equality, exact CLI stdout bytes, metered execution / CostReport / logical work (work.json conceptual 18/17 is conditional and unrun), general calendar/EOM/schedule generation, equity/share delivery, dividends, and native/proof/ledger/Preview/Fenrir/fee/target correspondence remain unasserted.

Execution and cleanup scope limits: the two older financial_pair tests (linked_installments_match_every_frozen_financial_prefix_and_total_work and approved_multiasset_reserve_matches_every_frozen_financial_prefix_and_total_work) compiled in the test binary but were filtered out by --exact and were not rerun. The only actual PASS was observed on df149c245d632853665a8a704e5e0f89176427f1 (tree a98ca0190564c9a078a091ac8a4eefc0c793f7bd), not executed afresh on 6c6e29651dc01322bb7eb8a18fc98b3c1e818231. Process and filesystem cleanup records cover owned session ID census and owned temporary root deletion only, not kernel-level syscall or detached-process exclusion. No security, authorization, or cryptographic soundness judgment is made.
